# cloudsmith_oidc (Data Source)

The `oidc` data source allows fetching of metadata about a given Cloudsmith OIDC (OpenID Connect) provider configuration. This can be used to retrieve information about existing OIDC configurations for use in other Terraform resources or to verify configuration details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_oidc" "my_oidc" {
  namespace = "my-organization"
  slug_perm = "my-oidc-provider-slug-perm"
}

output "mapping_claim" {
  value = data.cloudsmith_oidc.my_oidc.mapping_claim
}

output "dynamic_mappings" {
  value = data.cloudsmith_oidc.my_oidc.dynamic_mappings
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Namespace (or organization) to which this OIDC config belongs.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm identifies the OIDC config.

### Read-Only

- `claims` (Map of String) The claims associated with these provider settings.
- `dynamic_mappings` (Set of Object) Set of dynamic claim value -> service account mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_mappings))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider settings should be used for incoming OIDC requests.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mapping_claim` (String) The claim key whose values dynamically map to service accounts (dynamic providers only).
- `name` (String) The name of the provider settings are being configured for.
- `provider_url` (String) The URL from the provider that serves as the base for the OpenID configuration.
- `service_accounts` (List of String) The service accounts associated with these provider settings (static providers only).
- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the oidc.

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `claim_value` (String)
- `service_account` (String)
